turns.question: Of the people who applied to work here between 25 September and 2 October 2026, what share were still in the running at the end of 4 October?
turns.answer:
About 33% (2 of the 6 candidates who applied from 25 September to 2 October 2026) were still in the running at the end of 4 October 2026, counting the screen and interview stages as in the running. The other four had been hired (2) or rejected (2), and I counted hired as no longer in the running.
Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
